gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-pathway-extreme: Scribbled and relaxed, like a note passed across a desk. Coming Soon keeps its strokes bare and round, while Pathway Extreme brings a plain sans with rounded openings and a big x-height to steady the text beneath.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-piazzolla: Loose, friendly handwriting with a pen-and-paper feel. Piazzolla, a text serif with an e opened wide, does the careful, authoritative work; Coming Soon simply sounds personal, with an unvarying weight from word to word.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-preahvihear: Preahvihear reads wide open and modern, its tall x-height giving each sans-serif line plenty of room. Coming Soon is best at sounding casual and personal, and Preahvihear is best at staying out of the way.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-pridi: Coming Soon scrawls its casual letters with strokes that never pinch at the curves, a handwritten voice up top. Pridi's serif is tall and refined.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-pt-sans-caption: Casual and personal, drawn in flat single-weight lines. PT Sans Caption follows with big-bodied sans lowercase and inviting, unclosed bowls, so the handwriting and the text sit comfortably together.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-puritan: Puritan has rounded, open forms and oversized counters in e and a, a plain sans that feels approachable beside the handwriting above it. Its strongest quality is friendliness.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-questrial: Modern and tidy, in a quietly crisp way. Coming Soon handles the casual, personal handwriting best, while Questrial's flat single-weight sans-serif strokes carry the text with a tall, open build.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-radio-canada: Pen-and-paper letters with a lowercase that nearly reaches the capitals. Coming Soon is best at sounding personal, whereas Radio Canada's sans, tall and full with clear curve endings, is best at carrying text.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-radio-canada-big: Casual, in a thoroughly handwritten way. Radio Canada Big does the opposite job: its plain sans has a monoline skeleton and an x-height filling the line, where Coming Soon is simply the personal voice.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-readex-pro: Handwritten, loose and personal from the first word. Readex Pro answers with sans letters that have broad terminal gaps and a steady weight, so the casual heading and the text feel clearly distinct.
